method: Installed unmodified dist builds in isolated headless Chrome and Firefox profiles; imported templates.js and lib/templates.js from each extension popup origin via CDP / Marionette.
checks: All five exports import successfully with exact pack counts
All 65 templates format with task and heading replacements and no unresolved placeholders
All 65 templates format with safe missing-value defaults
Markup-like task and heading values create no elements when rendered with textContent
Every stage-4 line names the task
Voice templates use task and never heading
limitations: This checks the authored copy modules in installed extensions. UI integration remains task 3.7 and later tasks.
